chunks.arabic_text: وَ رَوَى ٱلْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ جَرِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي ٱلرَّبِيعِ ٱلشَّامِيِّ قَالَ:

translations.en: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Khalid ibn Jarir, from Abu Al-Rabi' Al-Shami, who said:

chunks.arabic_text: سُئِلَ أَبُو عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَامُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ تَزَوَّجَ ٱمْرَأَةً فَمَكَثَ أَيَّامًا مَعَهَا وَ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يُجَامِعَهَا غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَدْ رَأَى مِنْهَا مَا يَحْرُمُ عَلَى غَيْرِهِ ثُمَّ طَلَّقَهَا أَ يَصْلُحُ لَهُ أَنْ يَتَزَوَّجَ ٱبْنَتَهَا

translations.en: Abu Abdullah عليه السلام was asked about a man who married a woman and stayed with her for several days, but was unable to have intercourse with her, except that he had seen from her what is forbidden to others. Then he divorced her. Is it permissible for him to marry her daughter?

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ "لَا يَصْلُحُ لَهُ وَ قَدْ رَأَى مِنْ أُمِّهَا مَا رَأَى".

translations.en: He عليه السلام said: "It is not permissible for him, for he has seen from her mother what he has seen."

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning marriage prohibitions arising from a marital relationship even when intercourse did not occur. Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام rules that the man may not marry the woman's daughter because of the degree of intimate exposure that took place with the mother.
en.seo_question: Can a man marry his divorced wife's daughter if he did not consummate the marriage but had intimate exposure to the mother?

key_terms.يُجَامِعَهَا: to have sexual intercourse with her
